findings.reason: two sections ordered §16-then-§5 as declared cannot both be satisfied as written, so §5's write set needs `reckon/change_streams.py` (or §16 must leave `_FleetChangeWatch` in `serve.py`), and without it the §5 node either edits the wrong file or blocks.
findings.text: §16 moves `_FleetChangeWatch` out of `reckon/serve.py` into the new `reckon/change_streams.py`, but §5 (whose deliverable at line 137 changes that class's body — "`_FleetChangeWatch` … also calls spawn-on-change for the project whose inputs moved") is ordered after §16 by the map and declares its write paths at line 141 as `reckon/serve.py`, `reckon/compliance.py`, `docs/ui/velocity.jsx`, `docs/ui/state-loader.js` and the test files, with `reckon/change_streams.py` absent; §16's only compatibility promise covers names other files *import* from `serve.py`, not an in-module edit of a moved definition, so the §5 node is fenced out of the file it must change

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — commit 1631b4d87, `tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py`, `scripts/check_pure_move.py`, `every-module-fits-a-worker-window#s8` and all twenty census test files resolve, and the snapshot's declarations match the live plan.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §16's done-when is a token bound (`serve.py` at most 45,000 by the named test's estimator) with a declared negative control that returns a repointed patch to `serve` and makes that test fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §16 writes under the run directory and measures with the committed test's own estimator, naming no scratchpad or node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — `reckon/git_dates.py` and `reckon/change_streams.py` name the concern they hold and carry no stage, ticket or version tag.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the cited measurement reproduces exactly (`reckon/serve.py` 53,952 estimated tokens, `reckon/crew/review.py` 51,584, `reckon/ledger.py` 51,393, test red at 1631b4d87), the named move set sheds about 10,400 tokens to land under the bound, and the pure-move method plus `scripts/check_pure_move.py` is the method §8 of the cited plan defines.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §16 carries the one goal of bringing `reckon/serve.py` under the worker-window bound; both extractions are closed by the same measure.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §16 relocates `_FleetChangeWatch` into a new module that §5, ordered after it, must edit, and §5's write paths do not name that module.
